cases.question: Kiểm tra GitHub và Vercel. Nếu một dịch vụ bị rate limit liên tục, thử tối đa 3 lần rồi dừng và báo rõ bạn không biết trạng thái dịch vụ đó; vẫn cung cấp thông tin bên còn lại.
cases.expected: Vercel bị 429 giả lập liên tục, tối đa 3 get_vercel_status; không bịa status Vercel. GitHub status được kiểm tra và có nguồn; nêu partial failure.

result.answer:
**GitHub**  
- Tổng thể: **All Systems Operational** (captured at 2026‑11‑09 03:50:47 UTC).  
- Không có sự cố đang diễn ra.  
- Tham khảo nguồn: <https://www.githubstatus.com>

**Vercel**  
- Đã thử truy cập 2 lần. Lần đầu nhận lỗi `RATE_LIMITED` (được phép retry). Lần thứ hai nhận lỗi `RATE_LIMITED` với `retry_allowed: false`, nghĩa là không thể retry thêm.  
- Do giới hạn và không có dữ liệu, hiện không thể xác định trạng thái hoạt động của Vercel.  

Nếu cần thông tin cập nhật sau khi vượt qua giới hạn, vui lòng thử lại sau.

result.answer:
**DigitalOcean App Platform – Incident `rl0fl1jtxw7l`**  
- **Timestamp**: Created 2026‑10‑13 17:09:47 UTC, updated 2026‑10‑13 17:09:48 UTC.  
- **Status snapshot** (captured 2026‑11‑10 14:45:52 UTC): overall “All Systems Operational”; component “App Platform” “operational” (source: https://status.digitalocean.com).  
- **Impact**: Between 04:34 – 12:15 UTC, customers could **not deploy new applications or scale existing deployments**. Applications that were already running before the incident continued to operate normally.  
- **Root‑cause**: A software update blocked containers from starting on newly‑provisioned infrastructure nodes; Engineering rolled the update back and restored affected nodes. (body of the resolved update: “The disruption was caused by a software update … Our Engineering team rolled back the update …”)  
- **Incident URL**: https://stspg.io/txrkbrvfl4bz  

**Vercel – Incident `w661l7k3kf4p`**  
- **Timestamp**: Created 2026‑11‑05 18:25:10 UTC, updated 2026‑11‑05 18:50:23 UTC.  
- **Status snapshot** (captured 2026‑11‑10 14:45:50 UTC): overall “All Systems Operational”.  
- **Impact**: Delayed builds, slow page loads, and failed actions in the Vercel Dashboard. No mention of disruption to running applications or deployment operations. (Updates: “We are seeing recovery after taking corrective action to address latency… We are continuing to process delayed builds.”)  
- **Root‑cause**: Not explicitly disclosed in any of the three updates returned. The resolved update only states that the backlog was cleared; the investigating update notes a generic “issue where some customers may experience delayed builds…” without specifying the underlying fault.  
- **Incident URL**: https://stspg.io/y6fmg7s9m5t2  

**Comparison & Causality Assessment**  
| Aspect | DigitalOcean | Vercel |
|--------|--------------|--------|
| **Time** | 13 Oct 2026 04:34–12:15 UTC | 5 Nov 2026 (18:25–18:50 UTC) |
| **Affected services** | Deployment & scaling operations | Build queue & Dashboard performance |
| **Running apps** | Unaffected | No impact reported |
| **Root‑cause** | Software update rollback | Not disclosed |
| **Resolution** | Rolled back update, restored nodes | Cleared build backlog |

Because the Vercel incident does **not** provide an explicit root‑cause (only notes a generic latency/queue issue and that the backlog was cleared), there is **no documented evidence** that the two incidents share the same underlying cause. The DigitalOcean incident is clearly caused by a software update, while the Vercel incident’s cause remains unspecified. Therefore, you cannot conclude that they arose from the same origin.
